question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

The patronage bestowed in consideration of family relationships and not of merit.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Nepotism"** means the practice among those with power or influence of favoring relatives or friends, especially by giving them jobs. (कुशाग्रता)

 
 
• **Example:** The CEO was accused of nepotism when he appointed his nephew to a high-ranking position.
 
 
 
• **"Nepotism"** specifically refers to favoritism granted to relatives, often without regard to merit. (भाई-भतीजावाद)
 
 
• **Example:** Many employees were dissatisfied with the company's culture of nepotism, where family members were given promotions over more qualified candidates.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is** 'Nepotism'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Egotism** (अहंकार): Excessive sense of self-importance.

 
 
• **Example:** His **egotism** made it difficult for him to work well with others.
 
 
 
• **Mannerism** (आदत): A habitual gesture or way of speaking or behaving.
 
 
• **Example:** His **mannerism** of tapping his foot was quite distracting during meetings.
 
 
 
• **Neologism** (नवशब्द): A newly coined word or expression.
 
 
• **Example:** The term "selfie" is a **neologism **that has become widely accepted.
